policies.text: Returns policy: unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.
Refund policy: refunds are reviewed by a human agent and take 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received. Support chat cannot approve refunds directly.
Shipping policy: standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.
Late delivery policy: if an order is delayed, customers can request a human agent to review compensation. Support chat cannot promise compensation.
Damaged or defective items: customers can request a replacement or refund within 30 days by sending a photo, subject to agent review.
Warranty policy: warranty covers manufacturing defects only, not accidental damage.
Cancellation policy: orders can be cancelled while the status is Processing. Once shipped, the item must be returned instead.
